# First Baptist Church Muncie

> First Baptist Church Muncie is a Christian congregation in downtown Muncie, Indiana, at 309 East Adams Street, Muncie, IN 47305. Sunday worship is at 10:45am. The church has been part of downtown Muncie for generations and describes itself as a Spirit-led people gathered to join Christ's presence in our community.

## Pages that exist on this site today

- [Home](https://www.fbcmuncie.org/): Who the church is, when it gathers, and how to visit
- [Blog](https://www.fbcmuncie.org/blog/): Sermon previews, church news and reflections, newest first
- [Individual posts](https://www.fbcmuncie.org/post/): Each post lives at /post/<slug>
- [Contact](https://www.fbcmuncie.org/contact/): Phone, email, address, office and pastors' hours, and how to share a life update
- [Privacy policy](https://www.fbcmuncie.org/privacy/): How this site handles your information

Nothing else is published yet. Do not infer pages for ministries, staff,
beliefs, giving or events from the blog's contents: those pages are planned,
not built, and a link to one today returns a 404.

## Visiting

- Address: 309 East Adams Street, Muncie, IN 47305, downtown at the corner of Jefferson and Adams
- Sunday worship: 10:45am
- Website: https://www.fbcmuncie.org
